summary: Category counts and product lists share the buyable-variant predicate.
Catalog pages return complete card DTOs with batched relation fields, eliminating two follow-up reads per card in the real listing page.
Displayed prices use actual variants when stored sort summaries are absent or stale; positive-stock checks and cloned plain-object detail attributes preserve response correctness.
Pagination accepts only complete positive safe integers and canonicalizes generated links through the same parser.
Added repository and service regressions and nine source-based guides while preserving the existing architectural lint rules and indexed sort tie-break.
limits: Unit tests inspect production query arguments through spies; no live PostgreSQL catalog benchmark was executed.
Price sorting still uses denormalized summaries that future writers must maintain; separate count/page reads are not one concurrent snapshot.
The existing no-database static-parameter fallback remains; a production build does not validate live catalog queries.
Future cart, checkout and administration curriculum features remain outside this read-path change.

checks.command: Recorded complete suite and build/type checks
